audience: office and facility managers and security admins who manage door access with Kisi

useCases.title: Check which doors, controllers and readers are offline
useCases.text: The AI lists locks with online, locked-down and unlocked state, plus controllers and readers with online or offline status. You can find problem hardware fast.

useCases.title: See who has access to which doors
useCases.text: The AI lists access groups, the doors each group opens, the users in a group and role assignments. You can answer who can open a door or a place.

useCases.title: See who was present at a place on a day
useCases.text: The AI lists who was at a place on a given day, derived from unlocks, with first and last unlock and last door.

useCases.title: Check access cards and their status
useCases.text: The AI lists access cards with status (activated, deactivated or unassigned), assignee and last use. You can find cards that need cleanup.

useCases.title: Search the access log for unlocks and denied attempts
useCases.text: The AI searches the access log by event type, such as unlocks, denied attempts or lockdowns, and reads the result pages. This creates a temporary saved search in Kisi. No door or access right changes.
